version: CHRISTMAS TREE 4-3-2-1 · VOICE SYNC FINAL V1 · TACTICS FIRST
rule: narration text is locked; camera timing and tactical action must serve each sentence, never rewrite tactical meaning to rescue visuals

slots.visual: Front-three hook, then glide into the complete shape before the formation chapter.
slots.voice_text: 萨吉体育，上课了。如果说谁让圣诞树阵型成为经典，安切洛蒂一定是最重要的人之一。

slots.visual: One stable CENTRAL_MASTER. Highlight 4 defenders → 3 midfielders → 2 attacking midfielders → 1 striker without reframing.
slots.voice_text: 四后卫、三中场、两名前腰、一个前锋。四三二一，这就是圣诞树。

slots.visual: Structure shot: LCB-Pirlo-two side midfielders-first pressure; camera explains the passing reference, not the player alone.
slots.voice_text: 先看进攻。皮尔洛站在中场最深处，负责决定进攻方向。

slots.visual: Wider midfield structure: both side midfielders open while Pirlo remains the central anchor.
slots.voice_text: 他两侧的中场主动拉开，为他创造出球角度。

slots.visual: Relationship shot: Pirlo, Kaka, Seedorf and nearest defensive lines; retain formation anchors.
slots.voice_text: 当中场宽度打开，西多夫和卡卡就能进入两线之间，把后场控制连接到前场。

slots.visual: Wide structure showing both fullbacks as the source of true width; no side-chasing camera.
slots.voice_text: 但圣诞树没有真正的边锋，所以拉开球场宽度的任务，更多交给边后卫。

slots.visual: Strong-side relation → ball-led final-third flow → Kaka/Inzaghi finish. The ball triggers camera progression.
slots.voice_text: 中场吸引防守，边后卫从外线套上；一旦到底线，回传或者倒三角，往往比直接传中更危险。最后，卡卡负责突然加速，因扎吉只等待防线失去位置的那一刻。

slots.visual: Chapter reset to full defensive shape, then structure view of compact central block.
slots.voice_text: 再看防守。圣诞树的第一原则不是马上抢球，而是先守住中路。

slots.visual: Local right-side relation only after the ball reaches the flank; fullback outside, midfielder inside, center-back behind.
slots.voice_text: 球到边路后，边后卫压外线，中场堵住内线，让对手继续往边路走。

slots.visual: Stable relationship shot on RB + RCM + RCB; triangle protection is the subject.
slots.voice_text: 这时候形成三角保护：边后卫压外线，中场堵内线，中卫保护身后。

slots.visual: Widen first to show both sides before the switch; only go local on the weak side after the ball arrives.
slots.voice_text: 真正的弱点，是连续横向转移。阵型横移速度一旦跟不上，弱侧空间就会被暴露。

slots.visual: Structure view returns to central compactness; camera recenters with the block.
slots.voice_text: 所以，中路必须始终紧凑。

slots.visual: Central structure shot showing numbers, short distances and connection.
slots.voice_text: 圣诞树最大的优势，是中路人数多、控制强，而且球员之间的距离很短。

slots.visual: Wider structure showing natural flank underload / possible 2v1 without lateral camera chase.
slots.voice_text: 但风险也很明显：边路天然人数不足，对手很容易制造二打一。

slots.visual: Return to full 4-3-2-1 CENTRAL_MASTER and hold the complete shape through the closing line.
slots.voice_text: 阵型只是数字。真正决定它能不能成为经典的，永远是执行它的人。
